newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-HOWLEY FIT TO FACE IRISH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-HOWLEY FIT TO FACE IRISH.

text.p: Scrum-half Rob Howley has won his fitness battle to play for Wales against Ireland in the Five Nations championship on Saturday.
Howley, regarded as a virtual certainty for the Lions tour to South Africa, suffered a shoulder injury in training last week and has been receiving daily treatment.
But he was fit enough to participate in a closed practice session on Thursday and has been cleared to win his 14th cap.
Wales have already lost centre Allan Bateman and replacement flanker Gwyn Jones from their original squad through injury.
